messages:
alex: Quick sync — pricing change rollout dependencies. Need owners for: metering adapter, billing events pipeline, quota enforcement, contract hook mapping. Can we align on who does the handoff and what the minimal event schema is? Need decision by EOD Fri.

mira: I can take metering adapter integration. Planning to re-use the /events endpoint we already have. @sam can you confirm if the billing events consumer can accept an incremental schema?

sam: Yep I can take the billing consumer side. We should define a stable envelope. Minimal fields: customer_id, request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, timestamp, contract_plan_id.

jia: For quotas, @leo and I will own enforcement rules. Question: do we rely on the contracts service for plan lookups or cache them locally? Caching would help latency but needs invalidation hooks.

leo: Prefer cache with TTL + contract change webhook. @irina can you add a contract webhook that posts to /contracts/changes? We'll need delivery retries.

irina: I can add the webhook. Will post to https://internal.redwood/contract-webhooks and include these fields: contract_id, plan_id, effective_at. Will add retries and 409 backoff.

alex: Great. @mira please open a PR with the metering adapter spec and include sample events. Also ask for a small canary flow for top 10 customers.

mira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — contains sample event and adapter README. Sample event below:

```json
{
  "event": "token_usage",
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "request_id": "req_abcd",
  "model": "redwood-3b",
  "tokens_in": 45,
  "tokens_out": 120,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-16T18:24:00Z",
  "contract_plan_id": "plan_enterprise_v2"
}
```

sam: That schema looks fine. Two asks: add a dedupe id for idempotency and a numeric version field for schema versioning (v1, v2).

mira: Will update. Also adding a small test harness to replay events to the billing consumer.

alex: For rollout timeline: get the PR merged by Wed, run canary Thurs, and cutover Mon. If any contract edge-case (legacy plans) we'll fallback to meter-only mode. Please ping here after PR updates.

billing-bot: deploy-notice: Billing consumer staging deployed (sha: c3f2a9). If canary ready, trigger job `canary-billing-consumer` from CI.

jia: Quick check on quotas: do we need per-model caps or aggregate tokens? Product asked for both but we should start with aggregate per-customer and log per-model for now.

alex: Agreed. Start with aggregate per-customer; file a follow-up ticket to add per-model caps in Q2.

mira: Thanks everyone — I'll update the PR and tag reviewers @sam @jia @leo.

sam: Reviewing today. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll prep the quota rules and post the enforcement checklist.

alex: Closing loop — decision owners: metering adapter = mira, billing consumer = sam, quota enforcement = leo + jia, contract webhook = irina. Deadline: EOD Fri for owners to confirm detailed tasks.
